title: An algebraic space over a field is universally open over that field

difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a morphism p : X -> Spec(k) of algebraic spaces over a scheme S with k a field, p is universally open (source lines 1076-1081). The proof chooses a surjective etale U -> X with U a scheme, so that the composite U -> Spec(k) is universally open by the scheme case; for a test morphism Z -> Spec(k) the base change U x_k Z -> X x_k Z is surjective, hence the second of the two maps |U x_k Z| -> |X x_k Z| -> |Z| is open because the composite is and the first is surjective, and finally p is universally open by the local criterion.
